revision_summary: One quote fix required: multi_touch_patterns[1].touches[0] cites 01:29 for the sun-exposure quote, but that line is spoken across 01:34-01:56 ('I don't get a lot of sun... I have the limited amount of sun that gets on my roof... the left side barely gets any sun at all during... fall and winter and spring'); correct the ts to 01:34 (or 01:34-01:56 range). Additionally: (1) resolve the internal contradiction at cherry_pick_moments[2] (01:56) where the same moment is simultaneously praised as good instinct and flagged as objection_inversion_miss — pick one classification, and given the schema explicitly endorses redirect-to-design as a valid strategy (rebuttals.price_estimate_before_design), the miss framing should be softened or dropped in favor of crediting the strategy match; (2) reconsider interest_reason_audit.asked=true at 02:51 — the line is a hedge embedded in reassurance language, not a direct question to Carl, and a stricter 'asked: false' better reflects that the Verify interest-in-solar beat was never genuinely attempted; correspondingly re-tag the schema_reference on cherry_pick_moments[3] to reflect this is a Verify-beat omission rather than a motive-capture failure tied to the 02:51 line specifically; (3) add a note on the in-person visit framing at 00:18 ('come by and show you a solar design') since it may explain multiple button_up items showing as skipped in script_coverage — this is useful context for the manager that's currently missing; (4) soften the handoff_brief.closer_should_know framing to acknowledge the customer continued cooperating (agreed to send bill, agreed to Saturday) rather than asserting his doubts are unambiguously unresolved as near-fact.
